faqs.q: What are Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 used for?
faqs.a: 90/10 (C70600, CuNi10Fe1Mn) and 70/30 (C71500, CuNi30Mn1Fe) copper-nickel tubes to ASTM B111 and EN 12451, the standard tube for seawater-cooled condensers, coolers and desalination plants. It is listed in 7 sizes, 9.53–25.4 mm outside diameter.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30, such as IH-TF-CN-CUN-0095-089?
faqs.a: Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 part numbers begin with IH-TF-CN-CUN and then give the outside diameter in tenths of a millimetre and the wall thickness in hundredths of a millimetre. IH-TF-CN-CUN-0095-089 is 9.53 mm outside diameter by 0.89 mm wall, and IH-TF-CN-CUN-0254-165 is the largest size listed. Quote the full part number, or the standard, grade, OD and wall.

faqs.q: What sizes do Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 come in?
faqs.a: Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 are listed in 7 sizes, 9.53–25.4 mm outside diameter, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-TF-CN-CUN-0095-089 and IH-TF-CN-CUN-0254-165. The table includes 9.53 mm OD by 0.89 mm wall and 25.40 mm OD by 1.65 mm wall.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to order Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 to the right size and grade?
faqs.a: For Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30, quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the standard and grade, the outside diameter and wall (BWG or millimetres, minimum or average wall), the length and the quantity. We quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: What cooling-water velocity can Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 take?
faqs.a: The water velocity limit for Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30: 90/10 Cu-Ni 2.4–2.5 m/s in condenser tube (3.5 m/s applies to large-bore pipe only); 70/30 tolerates higher velocity than 90/10.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30?
faqs.a: For Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30, testing follows the governing standard: Eddy current per E243 (each tube) or hydrostatic/pneumatic alternative; Expansion pin test B153: 30% O61, 20% H55/HR50; Flattening at three places to 3× wall. Grain size 0.010–0.045 mm for O61. Mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 on request; third-party inspection by arrangement. Say on the enquiry which tests and inspection your project needs.

faqs.q: Which materials and grades are Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 available in?
faqs.a: Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 are available in these grades: C70600 / CW352H 90-10; C70620 90-10 welding grade; C71500 / CW354H 70-30; C71520 70-30 welding grade; C71640 / CW353H 66-30-2-2.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30?
faqs.a: Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 are made to ASTM B111/B111M, ASTM B359, ASTM B395, ASTM B466, EN 12451, ASTM B858, ASTM B154, BS 2871, IS 1545, JIS H 3300. Tell us the standard and grade on your enquiry; equivalent grades in other standards are indicative and are checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What do Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 connect to or fit with?
faqs.a: For Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30, condenser tubes are expanded into tube sheets and carried on support plates, and the tube metal must be matched to the tube sheet and water side to avoid galvanic problems. Related ranges are the [Copper Tubes](/c/copper-tubes) and [Brass Tubes](/c/brass-condenser-tubes) shelves.

faqs.q: How should Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 be inspected on receipt and stored?
faqs.a: Check Copper-Nickel Condenser Tubes, 90/10 and 70/30 on receipt against the order: outside diameter, wall, length, marking and the certificate heat numbers, and keep the ends capped until installation. Handle and store the material so the surface is not scratched or dented. The [Reading a mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1](/blog/en-10204-3-1-mill-test-certificate) explains how to read the certificate.
